issues.description: Extraction requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, but the repo contains no story data or generator, so the advertised tiny pipeline fails.
The end-to-end test depends on missing repository data instead of creating fixtures, causing the checked-in test suite to fail.
The documented tiny demo commands do not run from a clean checkout because required input data is absent.
Validation loads vectors from the manifest but instantiates whatever backend the current CLI config requests, allowing silent backend/dimension mismatches.
Preference validation also ignores the vector artifact backend metadata and can run against an incompatible backend or layer shape.
The HuggingFace preference path scores one activity with good-minus-bad logits rather than true pairwise preference logits as documented.
HuggingFace activation extraction has no truncation, batching, or context-length checks, so long stories can fail or exhaust memory.
The HuggingFace model is loaded normally and then moved to the target device, without device_map or low-memory loading, making the default 2B model fragile on common machines.
Configuration values are coerced but not validated, so empty emotions, invalid topic counts, or out-of-range thresholds crash later with unclear errors.
Extraction assumes at least one story and crashes via np.stack/min/max instead of reporting an actionable empty-dataset error.
Context validation does not handle zero matching scenarios, leading to empty-stack failures or invalid diagonal/off-diagonal summaries.
steering.min_reported_emotions is configured but not read anywhere, while steer_prefs hardcodes four emotions.
The number of steered emotions is hardcoded to four instead of using the config value.
pca_components_for_variance returns one component when threshold is 0, although zero variance requested should require zero components.
The tiny backend counts emotion lexicon matches with raw substring search, creating false positives inside unrelated words.
